name: Roundcube
title: Roundcube
subtitle: Webmail
description: Roundcube is a free and open-source webmail client with a rich set of features for managing email communications. It provides a modern, responsive interface for accessing email via IMAP and supports SMTP for sending messages. Roundcube includes calendar, contacts, and plugin extensibility.

fields.title: Domain
fields.details: The domain name where Roundcube webmail will be accessible. For example: mail.example.com

fields.title: IMAP Host
fields.details: The hostname of your IMAP email server for receiving emails. For example: imap.example.com or mail.example.com

fields.title: IMAP Port
fields.details: The port number used to connect to your IMAP server. Default is 993 for IMAP SSL/TLS connections.

fields.title: SMTP Server
fields.details: The hostname of your SMTP email server for sending emails. For example: smtp.example.com or mail.example.com

fields.title: SMTP Port
fields.details: The port number used to connect to your SMTP server. Default is 465 for SMTP SSL/TLS connections, or 587 for STARTTLS.

fields.title: SMTP Username
fields.details: The username used to authenticate with the SMTP server. Often this is your full email address.

fields.title: SMTP Password
fields.details: The password used to authenticate with the SMTP server for sending outgoing email.

fields.title: Skip Host Validation
fields.details: Set to true to disable SSL certificate validation when connecting to IMAP/SMTP servers. Recommended to keep as false for security.

fields.title: Plugins
fields.details: Comma-separated list of Roundcube plugins to enable. Default includes calendar and password change plugins.

fields.title: Upload Max Filesize
fields.details: Maximum allowed file size for email attachments. Use format like 5M, 10M, 25M, or 1G for larger limits.

fields.title: Postgres Database Name
fields.details: The name of the PostgreSQL database that Roundcube will use to store contacts, preferences, and other data. This value is auto-generated.

fields.title: Postgres Username
fields.details: The username for connecting to the PostgreSQL database. This value is auto-generated for security.

fields.title: Postgres User Password
fields.details: The password for the PostgreSQL database user. This value is auto-generated and should be kept secure.

fields.title: Postgres Root Password
fields.details: The root/admin password for the PostgreSQL database. This value is auto-generated and should be kept secure.
